audit.whatIsWrong: Chart disagreed with the already-audited Kennen page on rows 1, 2, 3 and 6, and the level-6 row claimed the spike for Tryndamere in both whys[4] and spikes[1] while the side said Kennen.
audit.why: The mirror settled the chart as Skill / Kennen / Kennen / Tryndamere / Kennen / Skill / Tryndamere. Level 6 is his: Slicing Maelstrom is 120 seconds, 550 radius, and its bolts keep applying Mark of the Storm, so it re-stuns through Undying Rage — immunity to death is not immunity to lockdown.
audit.corrected: Both layers flipped in matched pairs, ratings adjusted, and whys 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 plus spikes[1] and mid rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said to 'engage on Lightning Rush's cooldown' and treated it as his escape, with no numbers anywhere and no mention of the storm's radius.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom's 550 radius sits inside Spinning Slash's 650 range, so you can spin out of the storm — the opposite of what the page implied. Lightning Rush passes through units, so minions never block his exit. Thundering Shuriken is 950 range on 7/6.25/5.5/4.75/4, so the poke effectively never goes away. Three Marks of the Storm stun.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, phases[1].why, phases[2].why, phases[4].why, phases[5].why and late rewritten around those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Electrical Surge's on-hit behaviour was never stated, so the build advice read as a flat 'build MR'.
audit.why: It applies on-hit and scales with his attack speed, which is why magic resist reads the trade correctly and armour does not.

edits.after: First item is close: your crit-lifesteal out-damages his fragile body, but Electrical Surge applies on-hit and scales with his attack speed, so magic resist reads the trade better than armour does. Save Undying Rage for the three-mark stun.

edits.after: From level 4 you take over: Spinning Slash closes on his fragile frame and your crits shred him faster than his poke replenishes. Level 6 goes back to him — Slicing Maelstrom re-marks you and stuns through Undying Rage.

edits.before: First item and beyond stay favoured: your crit-lifesteal build melts his squishy body one-on-one, so keep the sidelane pressure on with Spinning Slash while only respecting his full stun-into-Maelstrom combo when his jungler is near.
edits.after: First item and beyond stay favoured: your crit-lifesteal melts him one-on-one, so keep the sidelane pressure on with Spinning Slash. Mocking Shout only slows a turned back, so it lands as he flees, not while he kites you facing forward.

notes: The old spikes[1] and whys[4] both told the reader that level 6 is his kill window because Undying Rage carries him through the stun-and-ult combo. Slicing Maelstrom re-applies Mark of the Storm as it ticks, so the combo is repeated stuns and the immunity does not answer it — this is the single most dangerous line that was on the page. Whether Tenacity or Cleanse meaningfully changes the maelstrom chain-stun is not in the kit data and I did not assert it.
